'''Operation Retribution''' was a series of operations organized by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lens Reekeene]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to harass [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activities in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Multiple targets across the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] were attacked by the Roughnecks, stretching their already scarce resources to the limit.<ref name="Assault" />

One target was an Imperial [[Space station/Legends|space station]], and the [[Assault on Repair Station M13|assault]] was intended to draw [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] away from [[Repair Station]] [[M13]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mycroft]]. After the TIEs and its [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] had departed Mycroft, [[Green squad]] was to assault M13. Their mission goals included harassing the base, capturing [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] for interrogation, the theft of much needed weapons and supplies, and the destruction of the facility if that was deemed possible. Their mission parameters called for the maximum amount of damage with the least risk, and to exfiltrate after two [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="Assault" />
